key_points: Banks take 3% - 6% hidden margin on exchange rate and £10-£25 foreign payment fees

slides.summary: This slide outlines the core user workflow and product mechanics for executing international money transfers. It details a four-step process involving booking, depositing, converting at mid-market rates, and delivering funds to the recipient.
key_points: Step 1: Book a payment by entering recipient details on the website
Step 2: Deposit money by transferring source currency to a holding account
Step 3: Convert currency through automatic matching at mid-market rates
Step 4: Send the converted currency to the recipient bank account
Includes website www.transferwise.com and date 31.05.2011

• e-Money services – PayPal, Moneybookers
